name: shopsphere
description: ShopSphere: a full-stack mini e-commerce app (React + Redux Toolkit frontend, Express + SQLite backend)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
